Error flag value = true when error occurs and this results in outlet going out of order. This can occur in one of the two cases mentioned below:
(a) Outgoing coils welded are detected when charging is OFF (this could happen in critical condition when power contacts are detected as welded with aux contact stuck {Fbk:1} or not stuck {Fbk:0} for long duration of time)
(b) If weld detection cannot be enabled due to internal error or when weld detection feature has been disabled and make-break timeout has occurred (this occurs when CMD:0, FBK:1 for time duration of 1 sec)
